NYMPH_THOUGHT_FTUE_BODY_1:
Thought is Nymph's special resource. You gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Thought[/gold] whenever you play a card.
The upper number is your [gold]Thought[/gold]. The lower number shows your [gold]Confusion Threshold[/gold] / [gold]Obstruction Threshold[/gold].
The Obstruction Threshold is [blue]2[/blue] times the Confusion Threshold.
NYMPH_THOUGHT_FTUE_BODY_2:
When [gold]Thought[/gold] reaches the Confusion or Obstruction Threshold, you become [gold]Confused[/gold] or [gold]Obstructed[/gold].
[gold]Confused[/gold]: your [gold]Attack[/gold] damage is reduced by [blue]20%[/blue].
[gold]Obstructed[/gold]: [gold]Attack[/gold] damage and [gold]Block[/gold] from cards are reduced by [blue]50%[/blue].
NYMPH_THOUGHT_FTUE_BODY_3:
Card keywords:
[gold]Conceive[/gold] grants extra [gold]Thought[/gold].
[gold]Narrate[/gold] converts [gold]Thought[/gold] into [gold]Block[/gold] and triggers follow-up effects.
